Requirements

Financial prices require at least two calendar years of actual history, hourly or finer native data (15 minutes preferred), valid timestamps and values, a verified price definition and no unexplained empty expected hourly blocks under the correct historical calendar.

Contextual predictors retain their native cadence and require reporting coverage, historical availability and revision evidence. Tweets and derived signals also require account collection completeness and causal processing lineage.

Audit window: 1 October 2024–30 September 2026. Dataset types follow the storage inventory; GDELT tone/GCAM attributes belong to GDELT. The public page contains aggregate counts only. Observations, identifiers, credentials and delegation tasks remain private.
